description: Hand-labelled retrieval evaluation set for the Filing Intelligence Platform.
relevance_rule: A retrieved chunk counts as relevant if it comes from a filing by the expected company AND falls within one of the expected Item numbers. Section-level labelling is used rather than chunk-level because chunk ids change whenever the chunker changes, which would invalidate the labels on every tuning run. The trade is that precision@10 is measured against a section, so a chunk from the right Item that does not literally answer the question still scores as relevant.
labelled_by: hand, from the filing structure, before any retrieval was run
